svg:
The one metric, per player, against his own no-skill rate Each dot is one player. X is what naming his biggest category every day scores - a predictor with no information about the outcome. Y is the share of his evaluated days on which the actual landed in the category the model called. Above the dashed line means the model beat naming that player's biggest category every day. The diamond is the population mean: 49.2% against a reference of 51.6%. The tests on these differences are in their own section of the document. A p value belongs to the test, not to a rate, so none is printed here.
